public_note: This Noether Paper 30 RA72 package is a narrow source-header and footnote-counter repair candidate, not a whole Paper 30 certification.

files.quality_label: Noether Paper 30 RA72 German source-header/footnote-counter repair candidate
files.coverage: Paper 30, Abstrakter Aufbau der Idealtheorie in algebraischen Zahl- und Funktionenkörpern, Mathematische Annalen 96 (1927), pp.26-61. The package contains a German cumulative TeX/PDF/log candidate, RA71-to-RA72 diff, GDZ official article PDF, IIIF source manifest and page/canvas map, raw first-page IIIF witness, labelled 1200dpi inspection crops, fix/disposition/source-crop CSVs, method note, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The source opening has the author block `Von` / `Emmy Noether in Göttingen.` and source footnotes on printed p.26 begin at `1)`. RA72 restores the source author block and inserts `\setcounter{footnote}{0}` before the Paper 30 body notes. No body prose or mathematics changed. XeLaTeX compiled successfully twice; the package notes only the standard inputenc warning under a UTF-8 engine.
files.limitations: Targeted source-apparatus/header repair evidence only. It does not certify every Paper 30 formula or prose line, does not promote a unified German branch, and does not propagate to English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic branches.
